en.title: PMS 7.9.2(2) and (4): broken cross-reference "subrule 0" in the refund rule (PDF and regulator's website)
en.summary: Both subrules refer to "subrule 0", an unresolved automatic cross-reference; the same "0" appears in the text on the regulator's website. The intended target is 7.9.2(1) (refund of an unauthorised Payment Transaction). The meaning survives by context.
en.correction: Please read "subrule (1)" for "subrule 0" in 7.9.2(2) and (4) (an editorial correction under section 19(3)(a) of the AIFC Regulations on AIFC Acts).
